Name: Space Cat
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
Just a mod because I wanted to have a crazy looking cat to go with my elf girl instead of the normal grey cat I'd picked?  SO I sat down and pixeled a bunch and got this cute little void eyed, STO inspired thingy which is now a space cat your farmer can have?

[s]I have 2 skins right now, the Midnight and Dusk Lunarian Caracals (Purple and teal), [/s] 
As of 1.2 I've got the Midnight, Dusk and Moonglow Lunarians and the Daybreak Solarian Caracals (STO makes a distinction so I'm sticking with it but it's just one group is cool colors the other is warm colors?)
1.3!  I've added 2 more, The Heatwave Solarian and the Pitch Lunarian Caracal (That means I've done all the Lunarian!  I'm not much for the other Solarian but there are some other types of Caracals that I'm eyeing)
As I get time and energy I'll probably add in more of the little buggers.  They're just so [i]damn cute[/i]!!

So Good news!  [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/15882179-aulberon/]Aulberon[/url] was sweet enough to go though the trouble of making an Alternate textures version of Space Cat! 
So now if you use AT you can grab that version!

Requires:
SMAPI
Content Patcher
(Optional) Alternate Textures

The default is set to "Midnight" which is the purple one. 
If you want the others you need to generate the config file and just change Midnight to your choice.  Being they're named after stuff that I don't expect peeps here to know?  I'm going to give yall a cheat sheet here.
Midnight: purple
Dusk: Teal
Moonglow: White/pastel Fuchsia 
Daybreak: Yellow/orange
Heatwave: Pink/Red
Pitch: Dark grey/black

Really this is just a dirt simple mod, I've never -Really- modded Stardew prior to starting this.
If you need to get ahold of me for one reason or another @ me over on the SDV discord.  LynnNexus just like here.
If you have a request for the next kitty I should do the colors of or wanna replace a different cat... Yea poke me on Discord.
